plan.title: Bulk Counter Offer Disabled Without Bids

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with no bids on its Responses tab.
Open the stage Settings menu where Send Bulk Counter Offer is offered.
Assert the menu item is present, greyed out, and has the required explanatory tooltip.
